title: ETFB
features:
AUTOMATION

Steal: Filters (Rarity/Mutation/Size/Generation), Strict Filters, Filter Rarity, Steal Mutation, Steal Size, Minimum Generation, Auto Steal, Auto Place Brainrots, Steal At Once.
Events: Select Events (Acid Rain/Storm/Tornado), Brainrot Source Filters (Rarity/Mutation/Size), Strict Source Filters, Acid Target Mutations, Storm Source Rarities, Storm Target Rarities, Tornado Target Sizes.
Collect: Auto Collect Collectibles, Select Items to Collect, Auto Deposit Candies, Candy Deposit Amount, Auto Deposit Orbs, Orb Deposit Amount, Auto Loot Crates, Select Wheels, Auto Spin Wheel, Auto Finish Obby, Auto Press Buttons.
Auto Index: Mutation Type, Auto Complete Index.
Auto Sacrifice: Auto Fire & Ice Sacrifice, AutoSacrifice Rarities, AutoSacrifice Amount, Auto Pot Of Gold Sacrifice, AutoPotOfGold Amount, AutoPotOfGold Rarities.
Tower Trial: Auto Tower Trial, Auto Claim Amount, Brainrot Priority (Time till death/Level).
VISUALS
Player ESP: Box ESP, Name ESP, Health ESP, Tracers, Team ESP, Skeleton ESP, Held Item ESP, ESP Max Distance.
Brainrot ESP: Name, Tracer, Value, Money Per Sec, Outline, Filter By (Rarity/Price/Money Per Sec), Rarity Filter, Price Filter (Any/Highest Value), Money/s Filter (Any/Highest M/S).
World Visuals: Better Graphics, Fullbright, Custom Time, Time of Day.
ECONOMY

Sell: Select Filters (Rarity/Mutation/Generation), Strict Filters, Sell Rarity, Sell Mutation, Sell Under Generation, Auto Sell, Include inventory, Sell Holding Brainrot (button).
Rebirth: Auto Collect Money, Auto Upgrade Base, Auto Rebirth, Auto Upgrade Speed.
Upgrade: Select Filters (Rarity/Mutation/Size), Strict Filters, Upgrade Rarity, Upgrade Mutation, Upgrade Size, Auto Upgrade Brainrot.
Fuse: Select Filters (Name/Mutation/Rarity/Size), Strict Filters, Select Brainrots, Select Mutations, Select Rarities, Select Sizes, 1st/2nd/3rd Item Count, Planned Order preview, Wait For Luck (minutes), Auto Fuse, Fuse Machines.
WORLD

Teleport: Teleport Method (Gaps/Bypass/BypassV2), Auto Teleport Speed, Draw Teleport Positions, Teleport Speed.
Exploits: Unlock camera zoom, Passthrough VIP Walls, Remove Walls, Instant Prompts.
Global
